text:
invoice-bot: New invoice received from Solaris Dataworks: INV-SD-559 for 18,900 EUR. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/INV-SD-559. Vendor cites PO: PO-13011. Extracted currency EUR; our PO is in USD. Flag: currency mismatch + VAT charged.

emma_fin: Quick scan 1: invoice total 18,900 EUR (incl. 20% VAT). PO-13011 in Coupa is for $20,000 USD (tax-exempt for US entity). Looks like vendor billed their EU entity with VAT.

oliver_proc: Procurement created PO-13011 to our US entity (Redwood Inc. USA). Solaris invoiced from Solaris EU. We did have a conversation about EU deployment but procurement didn't create EU PO.

marco_tax: If Solaris invoices from their EU entity, VAT may be recoverable only if we have their VAT number and local registration paperwork. We can't just flip the invoice to USD without vendor reissue.

yuki_ap: AP won't auto-match due to currency and vendor entity mismatch. Options: 1) ask vendor to reissue invoice from Redwood US vendor record (no VAT) with USD amounts, 2) create a new PO for EU entity and have Procurement/Tax validate VAT reclaim, 3) process payment to Solaris EU but need tax docs and supplier registration. Which is fastest?

rachel_ops: We're facing go-live next week for the EU region; we need services covered. Payment needs to clear in 5 days. Vendor said they can be flexible but need PO or confirmation.

vendor-bot: Solaris billing auto-reply: "We can reissue in USD from Solaris US if you provide US vendor account ID or instruct us to bill without VAT. Alternatively we can issue a corrected invoice referencing PO-EU-442 but need you to create that PO."

emma_fin: Procurement, can you create PO-EU-442 (EUR) tied to Solaris EU so vendor can reissue to match? If yes, Tax will need vendor VAT cert. If not, vendor reissue in USD preferred.

oliver_proc: I can spin up PO-EU-442 but need business justification and tax team sign-off. I'll open PR-1204 and tag @marco_tax. ETA 3 hours if approvals flow.

marco_tax: Send vendor VAT number and invoice PDF to tax@redwood. If vendor is registered EU VAT, we can reclaim. I'll review and sign-off quickly.

emma_fin: I emailed vendor asking for: 1) confirm VAT number, 2) whether they can reissue in USD to Solaris US, or 3) accept PO-EU-442 once created. Included AP ticket AP-7821.

vendor-bot: Vendor reply: "We are registered: VAT-EU-887766. We can reissue to your EU entity once you create PO-EU-442, or to Solaris US in USD if you confirm Redwood US vendor ID RDW-US-77. Which do you prefer?"

rachel_ops: I prefer USD payment out of the US entity to avoid VAT reclaim delays. Can Finance/Procurement confirm RDW-US-77 and ask them to reissue?

oliver_proc: Procurement can confirm RDW-US-77 but Solaris will need proof of our US vendor account (we send a vendor profile). I'll attach that to vendor email.

marco_tax: If they reissue in USD and no VAT, easy. If they insist on EU invoice, we'll do PO-EU-442 and reclaim VAT but that takes 6-8 weeks. For go-live, USD reissue is faster.

emma_fin: Plan: request USD reissue to RDW-US-77; if vendor cannot do within 24h, we create PO-EU-442 (PR-1204) and route for expedited approvals. AP: hold invoice until matched.

yuki_ap: Marking invoice HOLD-ENTITY-MISMATCH. Will not schedule for payment until vendor reissue or PO match.

invoice-bot: Vendor acknowledged request and will prioritize USD reissue. They expect USD invoice within 12 hours after receiving vendor profile.

emma_fin: Thanks team  I'll update AP-7821 when USD invoice received. If not in 24h we'll proceed with PO-EU-442 path.

oliver_proc: PR-1204 queued as contingency with expedited tag.

rachel_ops: :thumbsup: urgent because deployment depends on no-delay.

invoice-bot: Thread archived pending vendor reissue.
